expected: The dashboard, or no Dashboard item in the menu
actual: Redirected to /accounts every time

expected: A short "You don't have access to Billing — ask your admin" message
actual: Silently lands on the dashboard

title: Allergies tab says "0" and "No allergies recorded" right under the allergy noted at registration

expected: The count includes it (or the tab says "1 noted at registration, not yet confirmed")

title: Vitals accept "abc" as a blood pressure

title: Allergies typed at registration are ignored: the doctor is not shown them and amoxicillin gives no warning for a Penicillin allergy
steps: Front desk registers the patient with Allergies "Penicillin" → doctor opens the OPD consultation → Prescriptions → type "Amoxicillin" (or pick "Amoxicillin 500mg Capsule") → Add
expected: An allergy warning the doctor must acknowledge (amoxicillin is a penicillin)
actual: With the allergy only from registration ("Penicillin" in the Allergies box): the consultation screen shows no allergy anywhere, and prescribing amoxicillin gives no warning (typed: no message; picked: "not found in the drug catalogue"). Only after the doctor re-enters Penicillin as a structured allergy on the profile does the consultation show it and warn "Patient is allergic to Penicillin". KMCH records allergies at the front desk, so in practice the check is off.

title: Picking a drug from the suggestion list shows "Not found in the drug catalogue — interaction checks could not run"
steps: Prescriptions → type Amoxicillin → pick "500mg · Capsule" from the list
expected: The drug is recognised and checked for allergies / interactions
actual: Picked "Amoxicillin 500mg Capsule" (the app's own suggestion): "Not checked — Not found in the drug catalogue — allergy and interaction checks could not run for this name". With a structured allergy the allergy warning still appears beside it, but drug–drug interaction checks do not run for picked names.

title: ER evaluation error message does not name the wrong box

title: Receptionist adding an ER charge hangs on "Adding…" forever, nothing is billed
steps: Log in as the front desk → Emergency → Charges on Unknown Male (UDH-UH-2026-00021) → pick "Casualty Attendance — ₹800" (or Other: "Scalp wound suturing", ₹600) → Add charge
expected: The charge is added to the ER bill — or, if the front desk may not add ER charges, no Add form and a clear message
actual: The button turns to "Adding…" and never comes back; the total stays ₹400. addEmergencyCharge needs emergency:triage, which the receptionist role lacks (rbac.ts), so the server throws FORBIDDEN and the modal never resets busy or shows an error. Settings → Roles & access says "Emergency & accident register — already part of this role" for the receptionist, so there is no switch an admin could turn on to fix it.

title: Accident Register entry does not carry what the ER evaluation already recorded

expected: Age, ID marks, who brought the patient, state of consciousness, smell of alcohol and first aid pre-filled from the evaluation (editable)
actual: Only name, sex, MR No., alleged cause and arrival time carried over; age, both ID marks, who brought, consciousness, alcohol ("Not noted") and treatment must be typed again

expected: Age / Sex: ~35 y / Male
actual: Age / Sex: Male (the approximate age is only inside the name "Unknown Male ~35y")

title: ICU observation saves FiO₂ 150 %
steps: Critical Care → + Record Observation → HR 108, FiO₂ 150 → Save Observation
expected: Refused: FiO₂ is 21–100 %
actual: Saved

title: NEWS2 is scored from an incomplete observation — a ventilated GCS 7 patient drops to "NEWS2 3" and the High NEWS alert disappears
steps: ICU patient (NEWS2 14 on arrival) → Critical Care → + Record Observation → enter only HR 108 (and FiO₂) → Save
expected: NEWS2 is only scored when every parameter is present, or the partial score is marked "incomplete" and the last full score / alert stays visible
actual: Header shows "NEWS2 3 · just now"; the red "High NEWS — urgent clinical review" banner is gone; missing BP, RR, SpO₂, temperature and consciousness are scored as normal Also: a complete ventilated observation (E2 VT M5, RASS −3) still scores NEWS2 3 — with V = "T" the GCS has no total, so consciousness is not scored at all (earlyWarning.ts only uses avpu or gcs_total). Every intubated patient loses the 3 points for consciousness. And the 12:01 round with only blood sugar + insulin is scored NEWS2 2 and printed in the 12:00 column of the A3 ICU chart.

title: A care bundle can be signed with nothing ticked
steps: ICU patient with a urinary catheter → Day sheet → Care bundles → UTI → click "Sign UTI" without ticking anything
expected: Sign disabled until at least one item is ticked (or a confirm "Sign as 0/5 done?")
actual: Saved as "UTI · 0/5 · E2E Sister Kala 11:40" — a stray click records a signed, empty bundle

title: "New Order" does nothing while the Medications section is collapsed

expected: The order form opens
actual: Nothing visible happens; the form only appears after clicking the "Medications / IV / O₂" header to expand it (TreatmentPanel toggles showForm inside the collapsed section)

expected: A warning that a tablet cannot be given IV (or the route list limited to the form picked)
actual: Order saved as Pantoprazole 40mg Tablet · 40 mg IV once daily and sent to the pharmacy

title: Stopping a drug order takes one click, with no confirmation and no undo
steps: Treatment → Medications → click "Stop" on any active order (e.g. Mannitol 20% Infusion)
expected: A confirm ("Stop Mannitol 20% Infusion? reason…") or an Undo — the buttons sit close together on every card
actual: The order moves to "Stopped Orders" at once. During testing a mis-aimed click stopped Mannitol, Phenytoin, Paracetamol and the NS drip; all had to be re-ordered (and appear twice in the stopped list)

title: Order search ("Search pharmacy…") does not show which drugs the pharmacy stocks
steps: Treatment → New Order → type "Mannitol" / "Phenytoin" / "Paracetamol" → pick the first match → Add Order → Pharmacy → IPD Ward
expected: In-stock items marked (or listed first) so the doctor picks what the pharmacy can issue and bill
actual: The list mixes the national catalogue with stock and marks neither; 5 of 7 ICU orders picked from it arrive at the pharmacy as "Not in stock" and can only be dispensed unbilled (see BUG-018)

title: Running drip offers "Chart 3 ml" right after the bag starts, then refuses with "Already charted up to 11:56"
steps: Start NS bag 1 at 11:56 (80 ml/h) → Chart tab → Running drips → click "Chart 3 ml since 11:56" (or Chart amount 5 ml) before 12:06
expected: Either chart it, or say "Chart again after 12:06 (at least 10 minutes)" and hide/disable the button until then
actual: "Already charted up to 11:56." while the same row reads "charted 0 of 500 ml" — nothing has been charted; the server needs 10 minutes since the bag started

title: A stopped order's remaining doses print as "H" (held) on the drug chart and ICU sheet
steps: Order Ceftriaxone 250mg 1 g IV BD → Stop it → Day sheet / Print A3 / Drug chart
expected: Remaining doses shown as discontinued (struck through or "stopped 11:52") — not as doses a nurse held
actual: Every pending slot becomes status "held" (stopOrder, ipdTreatment.ts) and prints as "H"; when the drug is re-ordered the cells merge into "HG" / "H•", so the legal chart reads as if nurses held doses

title: Blood unit saved with an expiry date before its collection date
steps: Blood Bank → Add Unit → B+ Whole Blood, collected 12-11-2026, expiry 01-11-2026 → Add Unit
expected: Refused
actual: Saved

title: Separating whole blood into components always fails with a database error
steps: Blood Bank → Units → screened B+ Whole E2E-2611-02 → Separate → PRBC + FFP + Platelets ticked → Separate
expected: Three new B+ units (PRBC, FFP, platelets); the whole-blood unit marked separated
actual: Red text in the dialog: 'null value in column "id" of relation "blood_units" violates not-null constraint'. blood_units.id has no default (0005) and separateComponents (blood.ts) inserts the children without an id. No hospital can make components.

title: Request Blood requires the patient's blood group — no "Not known / group & cross-match" choice
steps: Unknown unconscious ICU patient (no blood group on record) → Request Blood
expected: An option to send the request ungrouped so the blood bank groups the sample (or uncrossmatched O-negative in an emergency)
actual: Blood Group * must be one of A+…O-; the doctor has to guess before the blood bank has grouped the sample

title: A negative blood processing charge is silently ignored — no message
steps: Blood Bank → Charges → Packed Red Cells ₹ -100 → Save
expected: "Enter an amount of 0 or more" next to the box
actual: Nothing happens; no message; the next value typed in the same dialog did not stick either until it was reopened

title: A request for 2 or more units gets stuck after the first unit — and its transfusion can't be recorded
steps: Doctor requests 2 units B+ PRBC → lab cross-matches BAG-2026-1005 → Issue Unit → issue it → try to cross-match / issue the second unit; nurse opens Blood Bank → Requests
expected: Cross-match and issue unit 2; the nurse records each unit's transfusion as it is hung
actual: After the first cross-match the card only offers "Issue Unit", which now says "No cross-matched units ready — record a compatible cross-match first", but the Cross-match button is gone (BloodClient shows it only while status = requested). issue_blood_unit marks the request issued only when all units are issued, and the Transfusion button needs status issued — so unit 1, already issued to the ICU patient, has no transfusion record at all. Every multi-unit request (the usual pre-op 2 units) dead-ends.

title: Cross-match results default to "Compatible" — one click records a compatible match nobody entered
steps: Blood Bank → Requests → Cross-match on the 1-unit B+ PRBC request → pick O+ BAG-2026-1002 → click Record Cross-match without touching Major / Minor or the sample number
expected: Major and minor results start empty and must be chosen; the recipient sample number is required
actual: Recorded as Major compatible · Minor compatible with no sample number (CrossMatchModal useState('compatible')); the unit was reserved and could be issued straight away

title: Transfusion times: end before start is accepted, and the times are stored 5½ hours off
steps: Blood Bank → Requests → Transfusion (Unknown Male, O+ PRBC BAG-2026-1002) → Start 12-11-2026 12:15, End 12-11-2026 11:00, pre-vitals → Record Transfusion
expected: Refused: the end is before the start (and start required); times saved as entered (12:15 IST)
actual: Saved and shown as "✓ Transfused 12 Nov, 05:45 pm". TransfusionModal sends the datetime-local text without a time zone, so the server stores 12:15 UTC = 17:45 IST; BloodTransfusionSchema has no checks (both times optional, no order check)

title: Expired units stay "available" and count in the Available total until someone presses "Expire Old Units"
steps: Blood Bank → Inventory / Units on 12 Nov with units that expired 26 Oct – 10 Nov
expected: Units past their expiry drop out of "available" on their own each day
actual: The tile said "9 Available" and the Units list showed 6 expired units as "available" until the manual button was pressed (cross-match does skip them, so they could not be issued)

title: Discharge balance ignores the advance on deposit — asks for ₹66,010 when ₹21,000 is already held
steps: Lakshmi: IPD bills ₹66,410, ₹400 paid, ₹21,000 advance collected (not yet adjusted) → Discharge → Normal discharge
expected: "₹66,010 billed − ₹21,000 advance held = ₹45,010 to collect" (or the advance applied automatically at discharge)
actual: "₹66,010.00 balance due — collect it before discharge" and "Cannot discharge — ₹66010.00 patient balance due"; the advance is not mentioned, so the doctor / family are told the wrong amount until billing does "Adjust Advance" bill by bill

title: No one-step "collect the balance" for an inpatient stay — settling took a top-up plus 7 "Adjust Advance" clicks
steps: Lakshmi at discharge: 7 unpaid IPD bills, ₹45,010 due → Billing → By Patient → Lakshmi → November 2026 → IPD
expected: A "Collect ₹45,010" for the whole stay (as the OPD row has), one receipt
actual: Only "+ Top Up Advance" and per-bill "↳ Adjust Advance"; the clerk must top up the advance by ₹45,010 and click Adjust Advance on each of 7 bills (or record 7 separate payments)

title: The discharge summary is lost when discharge is blocked for the bill
steps: Discharge → Normal → write the summary → Discharge Patient → "Cannot discharge — balance due" → close → billing settles → Discharge again
expected: The summary is kept (saved as a draft)
actual: The box is empty; the doctor has to write the whole summary again

title: ICU bed I1 was given to a second patient — and the new patient is missing from the ward board
steps: Emergency → Admit to IPD (Unknown Male) → Ward ICU → Room "ICU (6 beds avail.)" → Bed I1 → Admit. Then Ward Board → ICU
expected: I1 not offered: Murugan Pillai (IP-2026-00003, admitted 22 Oct) is in it
actual: I1 was offered and accepted; both admissions now point to I1. The Ward Board shows "I1 Murugan" only — the ventilated unknown patient does not appear on the board at all. The admit check trusts the bed's own status (likely "available" in the demo data) and never checks for another admitted patient in that bed. Ward dropdown also said "ICU (1 avail.)" while the room said "6 beds avail." Moving the unknown patient on to I2 with Transfer then set I1 free: the Ward Board now shows I1 empty although Murugan Pillai (still admitted, IP-2026-00003) lies there — so the board has now lost him instead, and I1 will be offered to the next admission again. Transfer frees the old bed without checking for another admitted patient (0291 added that check to move_admission_to_bed, not to transfer).

title: A male patient can be admitted to a bed in the Female General Ward without any warning
steps: IPD → Admit Patient → E2E Arjun Kumar (male) → Ward "General Ward" → Room → Bed F3 → Admit
expected: Only male beds offered, or a warning "Female ward — patient is male"
actual: Admitted to General Ward F3 (Female General Ward) with no warning

title: Summaries print "Length of stay: 1 days"

Clicking again eventually saved it (each failed try still advances the counter in get_next_referral_no) — so the counter on this hospital is behind numbers already used. Closing the dialog after the error lost most of what was typed.

title: Unknown patient's bill prints "PHONE: PROV-61A702E3"

expected: PHONE: — (not known)

expected: Refused: approval cannot exceed the claimed amount
